name: AGSM (Australian Graduate School of Management), UNSW Business School

program.options: Full-Time MBA 12 months (72 UOC); MBA (Extension) with an extra year

class_size.note: 'The AGSM Full-Time MBA program takes approximately 60 students'

tuition_total.note: AGSM program fees page: 2026 fee per course AUD 7,230, total estimated cost AUD 86,760 (Extension year +AUD 26,400). Degree page shows 2026 indicative full fee AUD 83,500 (domestic) and AUD 87,500 first year / AUD 88,500 to complete (international, includes ~AUD 1,000 study-related costs).

mandatory_fees_total.note: Non-tuition fees (e.g. student services and amenities fee, OSHC health cover) not stated on pages read.

living_budget_total.note: UNSW: from roughly AUD 28,860 per year (modest, on campus) to upwards of AUD 40,820 (own apartment); AUD 2,645-4,166 per month. Official visa floor (Home Affairs, from 10 May 2024): AUD 29,710 per year, per UNSW fees page https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/fees.

scholarship.note: Tuition fee waivers of 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% (e.g. Academic Excellence: min. one 100%, one 75%, two 50%, two 25%; Leadership Excellence; Global Reach; Women in Leadership). Average award and share of class not published.

employment.note: Class of 2025 graduating cohort: 87% accepted jobs within three months; 69% increase in salary post MBA (average starting salary vs average graduating salary; the salary itself is not published); 47% completed an internship or project; 4 students started their own venture. Only the top 4 hiring sectors are given (remaining ~45% not broken down). No salary level, function, geography or employer list published.

profile.note: Only 'candidates from more than 25 countries'; minimum 2 years full-time work experience.

rankings_cited.note: UNSW announcement: #48 globally, only Australian MBA in the top 100 (one trade outlet says 49th).

notes: UNSW news cites FT data: US$154,233 average salary three years after graduation (FT figure, not a school employment-report figure).
